en:
## New Features

- Routed NUG models by channel with channel-aware caching and delegation so provider selection stays accurate across model sources.
- Surfaced NUG provider metadata in model selectors to make channel and provider choices clearer.

## Bug Fixes

- Prevented stale or mismatched Service Workers from taking over API requests, fixing cases where WebSocket stayed connected while HTTP calls stopped working.
- Reduced false version-update banners by comparing the backend version against the current frontend build before prompting for refresh.
- Marked PWA entry files as no-cache so Service Worker and manifest updates are picked up more reliably.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 按 channel 路由 NUG 模型，并加入感知 channel 的缓存与委托逻辑，使不同模型来源下的 provider 选择更准确。
- 在模型选择器中展示 NUG provider 元数据，让 channel 和 provider 选择更清晰。

## 修复

- 阻止过期或版本不匹配的 Service Worker 接管 API 请求，修复 WebSocket 仍连接但 HTTP 调用全部失效的问题。
- 只有后端版本与当前前端构建版本确实不一致时才显示刷新提示，减少误报的版本更新横幅。
- 将 PWA 入口文件设为 no-cache，使 Service Worker 和 manifest 更新更可靠。
